messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — we're scheduling staggered control-plane restarts for GPU clusters across three regions next week. Target window: Wed 2026-04-01 02:00-06:00 UTC (west1), Thu 2026-04-02 02:00-06:00 UTC (eu3), Fri 2026-04-03 02:00-06:00 UTC (apac1).

maya_p: Why control-plane restarts vs node reboots? Is this for kube-apiserver/etcd patches?

alex_k: Yep — a security patch to etcd + apiserver memory leak fix. We need API server restarts to pick up new arg parsing and to avoid stale leader election races. No kernel/firmware work this time.

eric_sre: Key operational notes: keep at least 25% spare GPU capacity in each region before starting. We'll rely on autoscaler but will also pre-warm a few reserved instances to avoid cold-starting big jobs.

linh_infra: Proposed flow: canary in west1 (single AZ), validate scheduler and job preemption behavior, then proceed cross-AZ. We'll drain control-plane endpoints from prometheus-managed LB before restart.

maya_p: Customer-facing impact? Dedicated & Private customers with pinned models — any expected disruption?

alex_k: For Hosted API customers we expect no user-visible errors if we maintain buffer and routing. Dedicated customers will get a separate notice; for Private, we will only touch control-plane pods in the managed control plane — no on-prem changes.

eric_sre: Rolling plan details: 1) shift traffic off primary apiserver via nginx-weight 0. 2) scale-down leader replicas to 0 -> restart -> scale back. 3) run healthcheck script: `./scripts/check-controlplane.sh --all` 4) wait 10m for KV cache warmup.

linh_infra: Drain commands (for reference):
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-control-01
kubectl drain node/gpu-control-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
systemctl restart redwood-control-plane
```

maya_p: Can we automate the 10m warmup check with alert rollback if latency > 150ms for 5m?

eric_sre: Yes — adding a composite monitor: `api_latency_p50 > 150ms` & `error_rate > 0.5%` -> auto-rollback to previous apiserver image and notify #incidents.

alex_k: Ops checklist for the window (short):
- Confirm spare GPU pools (25% min) and pre-warm reserved nodes
- Notify customers (hosted status page + Dedicated emails) 48h prior
- Run canary in west1, validate 30m of steady metrics
- Proceed to eu3, apac1 if green
- Post-maint smoke test: embeddings, streaming gen, latency SLOs

linh_infra: Cost note: pre-warming reserved nodes ~4x on-demand for 1h across regions = ~0.6k USD; propose billing to infra budget.
maya_p: ack for budget ask — will loop in finance for a quick approval.

eric_sre: Oncall rota: @eric_sre primary, @linh_infra secondary for west1 canary. I'll be on-call for entire west1 window and first 30m of subsequent regions for rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `maintenance/controlplane-2026-04` — will post updates to #status-hosted during execution. :gear:

alex_k: If anyone sees large-scale pod evictions or scheduler thrash during canary, abort and revert. We'll reconvene in #eng-infra immediately.

maya_p: Thanks — I'll draft the customer notice and the internal runbook. Will drop links when ready. :thumbsup:

linh_infra: One more: please label critical long-running training jobs with `maintenance-safe=false` if they must not be preempted; we'll coordinate manual holdoffs.

eric_sre: Copy. Everyone, please ack in-thread if you have any objections or blockers before EOD tomorrow.
